name: 🫔 Cheesy Beef Enchiladas
what: Beef and bean tortillas rolled up, covered in sauce and cheese, and baked.

core.name: Enchilada sauce
core.out: salsa or a jar of marinara + cumin

extras: onion, black beans, sour cream, cilantro, limes, avocado, cumin, chili powder

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to 375°F.
Brown the beef with a diced onion; drain the fat. Stir in cumin, beans and a little sauce.
Sauce on the bottom of a 9×13 dish. Fill each tortilla with beef and cheese, roll, and lay seam down.
Pour the rest of the sauce over, covering the ends. Cheese on top. Bake covered 15, uncovered 10.
Top with sour cream, cilantro and avocado.

key: Cover the tortilla ends with sauce so they don't go hard.
done: Bubbling all over and the cheese is melted.
plan_b: Skip the rolling: layer tortillas, filling and sauce like a lasagna.
